caption: The drawing features a central, detailed illustration of a rolling pin rendered in shades of brown, giving it a wooden appearance with varied highlights and shadows to suggest its cylindrical form and rounded handles at both ends. The rolling pin is diagonally oriented from the lower left to the upper right corner of the main rectangular frame within the drawing. To the upper left of the main object, there is a lightly sketched set of concentric circles inside a square, drawn with thin pencil lines. To the lower right of the main object, there is a simple line drawing of the outline of a rolling pin inside a vertical rectangle. The entire composition is set on a pale, off-white background, and the overall drawing contains various rectangular and square outlines in pencil, framing each section. The name "Manuel G. Pereyra" is signed in pencil at the bottom center of the main rectangle.
title: Dough Rolling Pin
